memories.author: patient
memories.text: Started new inhalers as prescribed. Felt slight throat irritation after first use of budesonide-formoterol, but improved after rinsing mouth. Using salbutamol only before morning walk. No night awakenings.

- Diet: Breakfast: oats with milk and fruit. Lunch: chapati, dal, vegetable curry. Dinner: vegetable khichdi, curd. Snacks: roasted chana, avoid biscuits.
- Weight: 67 kg, Waist: 76 cm (within limit).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.85 L (88% predicted), FVC 3.60 L (92% predicted), FEV1/FVC 79%. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 increase 12% and 0.30 L, indicating reversible airflow obstruction consistent with asthma.

- Diet: Breakfast: idli with sambar, chutney. Lunch: brown rice, lentil soup, steamed veg. Dinner: grilled fish, salad. Snacks: apple, avoid fried snacks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: To: Dr. S. Rao, Pulmonologist, Jayanagar. Reason: Persistent mild eosinophilia and borderline IgE despite good asthma control, to rule out allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis. Requested: serum Aspergillus IgG, HRCT chest if indicated. Please advise on further management.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: From Dr. S. Rao: Serum Aspergillus IgG negative, HRCT chest normal. No evidence of ABPA. Continue current asthma therapy. Recommend annual influenza vaccination and consider allergy testing if symptoms worsen.
